response.sql: SELECT sc.zoneref AS site_reference, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST, sc.zoneref, s.insurstat LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The fraction's denominator is all conservation records that match a site (inner join), not just the top 10 combinations and not all conservation records.
A NULL insurstat is kept as its own group (NULL), and is shown as NULL.
Ties in fraction are broken by site reference and then insurance status, to make the top 10 deterministic.
